settings.hero_body: There is something nice about coming back to a space that feels like you. Eight colorful companions can be a familiar little sight waiting in your favorite corner.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Give your home a little welcome crew.
settings.final_body: Bring all eight into the space you return to every day.
settings.moods_title: Eight faces to come home to.
settings.moods_body: The whole pictured crew is included in one set.
settings.personality_title: Make the everyday arrival a little sweeter.
settings.personality_body: Choose a spot you pass when you come in: a bookshelf, a desk or your bedside. The collection is a small way to make a room feel more personal.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: Make the everyday arrival a little sweeter.
